working_features: A pygame window opens and displays a grid-based playing field
A snake appears on the grid and can be controlled with arrow keys
The snake moves continuously in the current direction at a steady pace
Food spawns at a random unoccupied position on the grid
The snake grows longer by one segment when it eats food
A score counter is displayed on screen and increments when food is eaten
Game ends when the snake collides with the wall boundaries
Game ends when the snake collides with its own body
A game over screen is displayed with the final score
The game can be restarted by pressing a key after game over
